recipe.visualDefinition: A central tattooed male figure in a white t-shirt and camouflage pants leads a large, aggressive crowd of men wearing red balaclavas and white long-sleeve shirts through a narrow city street canyon. The perspective is low-angle, emphasizing the scale and forward momentum of the group.
coreVisualRelationships: Central leader vs. uniform anonymous followers
High-contrast red masks against neutral urban tones
Aggressive, distressed title text vs. clean, wide-spaced metadata text
Deep perspective created by converging city buildings
coreInvariants: Red balaclavas as the primary color pop
Distressed, brush-stroke typography for the main title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central protagonist is mid-ground, flanked by two larger figures in the immediate foreground, creating a triangular formation.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central leader's face and the vibrant red masks of the surrounding crowd.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top distressed title, move down to the central leader, then radiate outward to the red-masked crowd and down the street perspective.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with figures to create a sense of overwhelming numbers.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral grays and whites (buildings, shirts, street).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red (balaclavas) providing high-frequency visual hits.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Earth tones (camo pants, boots, skin tones).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation on the red masks contrasts with the desaturated, gritty urban background.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to red, white, gray, and olive drab

letterConstructionRules: Tapered, sharp terminals resembling claws or scratches
Inconsistent baseline and cap height for a chaotic feel
Heavy weight with visible internal texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'A' and 'W' feature elongated, sharp extensions
Oversized first and last letters of words

anatomy.contrast: high (thick strokes vs. thin dry-brush edges)

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between chaotic, textured display type and clean, architectural metadata type.
graphicDevices: Splatter effects around the main title

avoid: Clean, corporate fonts for the title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive, scratched brush aesthetic
Provides the clean, wide-tracked contrast for the bottom text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle shot of a tattooed man in a white t-shirt and camo pants leading a massive crowd of men in red balaclavas and white shirts down a narrow New York style street. Gritty, high-contrast urban lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, black, dry-brush distressed title at the top center with a slight arc. Add a clean, wide-tracked sans-serif name at the bottom center in semi-transparent light gray.

verificationChecks: Is the red of the masks the most vibrant element?
Does the title text look hand-painted and aggressive?
Is the perspective low-angle and deep?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red on the masks
Amount of distress/splatter on the title text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the leader
Exact letter shapes of the title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the crowd feels like a single unit following the leader.
Check that the red masks don't look like flat blocks of color.
Verify the title text is legible despite the distress.
Confirm the low-angle perspective is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Resistance + Aggressive Brush Typography + Red Mask Contrast + Low-Angle Perspective
